criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Transaction Issues
categories.definition: Inquiries related to problems with transactions, including double charges, failed payments, and incorrect amounts.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests for assistance with account-related tasks, such as opening, modifying, or deleting accounts.

categories.name: Card Activation and Management
categories.definition: Questions about activating, managing, or troubleshooting issues with physical or virtual cards.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Inquiries regarding the process and requirements for verifying identity for banking services.

categories.name: Currency Exchange and Fees
categories.definition: Questions about currency exchange rates, fees associated with transactions, and supported currencies.

categories.name: Transfer Services
categories.definition: Inquiries related to sending or receiving money, including transfer delays and policies.

categories.name: Lost or Stolen Cards
categories.definition: Requests for assistance regarding lost or stolen cards and the necessary steps to take.

categories.name: Top-Up Services
categories.definition: Questions about adding funds to accounts, including methods, limits, and verification processes.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about various fees associated with banking services, including card payments and withdrawals.

categories.name: Technical Issues
categories.definition: Requests for help with technical problems related to apps, online banking, or card functionalities.

categories.name: Refund Requests
categories.definition: Inquiries about obtaining refunds for transactions or services.

categories.name: PIN and Security
categories.definition: Questions related to PIN management, security features, and account access.

categories.name: Child Accounts
categories.definition: Inquiries about opening accounts for minors and related requirements.

categories.name: Contactless Payments
categories.definition: Questions regarding the use and troubleshooting of contactless payment methods.

categories.name: ATM Services
categories.definition: Inquiries related to ATM usage, including withdrawal issues and supported transactions.
